# rule constraint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ruleConstraint`](gmeow-ruleConstraint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ruleConstraint>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a rule to a constraint that conditions it ([odrl:constraint](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/constraint)). A permission/prohibition/duty holds only when all its constraints are satisfied.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Rule`](../classes/gmeow-Rule.md) -> [`gmeow:Constraint`](../classes/gmeow-Constraint.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ruleConstraint`](gmeow-ruleConstraint.md) from [`gmeow:Rule`](../classes/gmeow-Rule.md) to [`gmeow:Constraint`](../classes/gmeow-Constraint.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to condition a rule on a constraint (the [odrl:constraint](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/constraint) link) — a permission, prohibition, or duty that holds only when the constraint is satisfied.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it to combine constraints (membership of a boolean combination is [`gmeow:logicConstraintMember`](gmeow-logicConstraintMember.md)) and avoid attaching it to anything but a [`gmeow:Rule`](../classes/gmeow-Rule.md).

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:ruleConstraint`](gmeow-ruleConstraint.md) links from a rule to its conditioning [`gmeow:Constraint`](../classes/gmeow-Constraint.md); multiple constraints on one rule are conjunctive unless wrapped in a [`gmeow:LogicalConstraint`](../classes/gmeow-LogicalConstraint.md).

### Examples

- ex:mayReproduce [`gmeow:ruleConstraint`](gmeow-ruleConstraint.md) ex:until2030.
